summary: Kennedy-Wilson Holdings disclosed via 8-K that its subsidiary commenced a fundamental-change offer to purchase any and all outstanding 5.000% Senior Notes due 2031 for cash, triggered by a planned going-private merger. The merger agreement, dated February 16, 2026 and amended March 15, 2026, involves a consortium led by Chairman/CEO William McMorrow and Fairfax Financial Holdings; the buyer group will acquire the company for an undisclosed per-share price. The subsidiary also priced $1.8B of new senior notes and issued redemption notices for 2029/2030 notes, all conditioned on merger close. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory clearance.
